decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana and cheat in powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. By putting big threats into play early, the deck puts pressure on the opponent and can win the game in just a few turns. The deck also includes ways to protect its combo pieces with cards like Force of Will and Flusterstorm. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures before they have a chance to respond.

The deck focuses on using efficient card draw, counterspells, and removal to quickly get key combo pieces into the graveyard, such as Troll of Khazad-dûm and Archon of Cruelty, and then utilize Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield. The strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up a powerful reanimation combo to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus to slow down the opponent's game plan and protect its own combo pieces.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing cards like Murktide Regent, Brazen Borrower, and Baleful Strix to quickly control the board and pressure opponents. The deck includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also protecting your own threats. The inclusion of powerful tempo spells like Daze and Wasteland allows you to maintain control of the game and dictate the pace. Overall, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans while presenting a fast clock to close out games efficiently.

This deck revolves around using artifacts to generate mana and control the board, with the ultimate goal of assembling the Mystic Forge combo to draw into win conditions and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes ways to untap artifacts for additional mana generation, along with the ability to search for key pieces using Urza's Saga. Karn, the Great Creator can shut down the opponent's artifacts while also providing additional utility for the deck. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifact synergies.

The key concept of this Aggro - Death & Taxes deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with disruptive creatures like Magus of the Moon and Spirit of the Labyrinth, while utilizing powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat and Swords to Plowshares to quickly close out the game. The deck also uses Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and has a strong mana denial strategy with cards like Wasteland and Karakas. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and control the game with disruptive elements to secure a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast and aggressive tempo. This is achieved through a combination of creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, along with powerful spells like Fatal Push and Force of Will. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Thoughtseize and Wasteland to control the opponent's resources. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student serves as card advantage engine, while cards like Psychic Frog and Brazen Borrower provide additional tempo advantage. The overall strategy is to control the board and tempo of the game to come out on top.

The deck revolves around cheating powerful creatures into play quickly through the combination of Show and Tell and Sneak Attack, while also utilizing cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal for fast mana acceleration. The main goal is to put out game-ending threats such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Griselbrand as early as possible, overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to react. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn, using cards like Omniscience and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to support its combo strategy.

This deck aims to generate a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, while using Brainstorm and Echo of Eons to dig for combo pieces. The goal is to play Song of Creation to draw through the deck, then cast Tendrils of Agony to deal lethal damage. Burning Wish allows for extra utility in fetching specific cards from the sideboard, while Veil of Summer offers protection against disruption. The deck utilizes a combination of fast mana and card draw to set up a powerful storm turn and win the game in a single explosive combo.

The main concept of the deck is to use a combination of spells and creatures to quickly mill through your library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Fell the Profane. Cards like Lotus Petal, Simian Spirit Guide, and Dark Ritual allow for fast mana ramping, while Boggart Trawler and Undercity Informer help with the mill strategy. Pact of Negation provides protection for key combo pieces, and Cabal Therapy can disrupt opponent's plans. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure a win.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Mystic Forge and other key artifacts like Basalt Monolith and Karn, the Great Creator to create a powerful combo that allows for fast mana acceleration and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Voltaic Key and Pithing Needle, the deck is able to control the board and manipulate artifacts to its advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful engine that generates threats and card advantage.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Griselbrand using cards like Entomb, Faithless Looting, and Thoughtseize. By reanimating these creatures with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead, the deck can overwhelm the opponent with massive threats early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal help to accelerate the combo, while disruptive cards like Unmask and Cabal Therapy can disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's key strategy is to cheat out powerful creatures from the graveyard and win the game before the opponent can react.

The main focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Tomb to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Thought-Knot Seer and Devourer of Destiny. The deck also uses disruption and control elements like Chalice of the Void and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient creatures while also controlling the board to ensure victory. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to use the synergy between Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. By naming a color with Painter's Servant, all cards milled with Grindstone will be of that color, leading to a win condition of emptying the opponent's library. The deck also includes various control elements such as Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast, as well as mana acceleration and tutors to help assemble the combo quickly. The overall strategy revolves around setting up the combo and protecting it until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this deck is to combo off with Mystic Forge and manipulate artifacts to generate infinite mana using cards like Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith. This allows for powerful plays using Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opponent's strategies or to search for key artifacts. The deck also includes cards like Urza's Saga and Urza's Workshop to support the artifact theme and generate additional mana. Ultimately, the goal is to establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifact synergies and combos.

This deck focuses on utilizing Eldrazi creatures and powerful artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By ramping up mana using Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Tomb, the deck can play big threats like Glaring Fleshraker and Karn, the Great Creator ahead of schedule. The inclusion of Sowing Mycospawn and Elvish Spirit Guide helps to accelerate the deck's game plan even further, ensuring a fast and furious assault on the opponent. With strong support from cards like The One Ring and Boseiju, Who Endures, this deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield early and press its advantage relentlessly.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly assemble and cast Doomsday, a powerful combo spell that allows the player to rearrange the top 5 cards of their library to set up a winning combination. The deck includes various ways to find and protect Doomsday, such as Brainstorm, Ponder, and Force of Will, as well as cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to generate mana quickly. Once Doomsday has been cast, the player can use cards like Thassa's Oracle to win the game by drawing their entire deck and ensuring victory.
